options.name: allowed_source
options.description:
Restrict IP Load Balancing access to these ip block.
No restriction if null.
You cannot specify allowedSource and deniedSource both at the same time

options.name: dedicated_ip_fo
options.description: Only attach frontend on these ip. No restriction if null

options.name: default_farm_id
options.description: Default HTTP Farm of your frontend

options.name: default_ssl_id
options.description: Default ssl served to your customer

options.name: denied_source
options.description:
Deny IP Load Balancing access to these ip block.
No restriction if null. You cannot specify allowedSource
and deniedSource both at the same time

options.name: disabled
options.description: Is the fronted disabled?

options.name: frontend_type
options.description: Type of the frontend, must be ("http","tcp","udp")

options.name: hsts
options.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security. Default: 'false'

options.name: http_header
options.description:
Add header to your frontend.
Useful variables admitted : %ci <=> client_ip, %cp <=> client_port

options.name: lb_name
options.description: Name of the IpLoadBalancer

options.name: name
options.description:
Human readable name for your frontend, this field is for you
This value must be unique for this module to work.

options.name: ovh_api_application_key
options.description: Application Key obtained from OVH

options.name: ovh_api_application_secret
options.description: Application Secret obtained from OVH

options.name: ovh_api_consumer_key
options.description:
Consumer key, created via OVH-Api and configured with the rights
to use all the needed endoints (the one that you will be using)

options.name: ovh_api_endpoint
options.description: Which OVH Api endpoint to use

options.name: port
options.description:
Port(s) attached to your frontend.
Supports single port (numerical value),
range (2 dash-delimited increasing ports) and
comma-separated list of 'single port' and/or 'range'.

Each port must be in the [1;49151] range.

options.name: redirect_location
options.description: HTTP redirection (Ex: http://www.ovh.com)

options.name: ssl
options.description: SSL deciphering.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate the desired state of the Frontend

options.name: zone
options.description: Zone of your frontend. Use "all" for all owned zone.
